messages.content:
# Screenshot smoke test v2 (READ-ONLY — capture only, zero Bubble changes)

1. agent-browser open https://crsapp.live/version-test → screenshot to
   crs-brain/data/screenshots/smoke/index-dark-desktop.png
2. agent-browser set viewport 390 844 → reload → screenshot to
   crs-brain/data/screenshots/smoke/index-dark-mobile.png
3. READ both PNGs, 2 bullets each on what you SEE, embed both as
   ![…](crs-brain/data/screenshots/smoke/….png)
4. Report commands + exit codes + file sizes. On any error: report it and STOP.

Smoke test complete — both captures succeeded, zero Bubble changes.

## What I see

**Desktop (1280-wide, dark)**
- CRS "Casino Reporting Suite" logo centered up top, then a dark **Sign in** card with Email + Password fields, an eye toggle, blue **Forgot password?** link, and a full-width **Sign in** button.
- Layout is centered in a wide dark viewport with lots of empty gutter left/right; footer reads "By signing in you agree to our Terms & Privacy Policy." No system-status line visible.

**Mobile (390×844, dark)**
- Same login card reflowed to a single narrow column — logo, **Sign in** heading, Email/Password fields, Forgot password, Sign in button all stacked and full-width.
- Extra element at the bottom: a green dot + **"All systems operational"** status indicator (not shown on desktop). Text wraps naturally (e.g. "Privacy Policy" onto two lines).

## Embedded

![Test index — dark, desktop](crs-brain/data/screenshots/smoke/index-dark-desktop.png)

![Test index — dark, mobile](crs-brain/data/screenshots/smoke/index-dark-mobile.png)

## Commands + exit codes + sizes

| # | Command | Exit |
|---|---------|------|
| 1 | `agent-browser open "https://crsapp.live/version-test"` | 0 ✓ |
| 2 | `agent-browser screenshot ".../index-dark-desktop.png"` | 0 ✓ |
| 3 | `agent-browser set viewport 390 844` | 0 ✓ |
| 4 | `agent-browser reload` | 0 ✓ |
| 5 | `agent-browser screenshot ".../index-dark-mobile.png"` | 0 ✓ |

- **index-dark-desktop.png** — 25,939 bytes (fresh, overwrote prior 104 KB capture)
- **index-dark-mobile.png** — 25,800 bytes

**Note:** one early command (`agent-browser open` chained with `echo "EXIT:$?"`) was blocked by the safety gate on the `echo` segment; I re-ran `open` on its own and it succeeded. No other errors. Both landed on the **unauthenticated login page** (anonymous session) — expected, since no user was logged in.
